paper.title: CompactFlow: Opportunistic Execution and Self-Evolving Policies for Efficient Agentic Workflows
paper.original_numeric_settings: TBD in supplied PDF; these defaults are new reproducibility choices

model.name: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct
model.authentication: optional bearer key from environment; never serialized
model.seed_support: seed forwarded; GPU/API output reproducibility is not guaranteed
model.truncation: reject oversized request; never silently truncate

tokenizer.accounting: provider prompt_tokens + completion_tokens; reasoning included in completion if reported
tokenizer.missing_usage: mark run non-reportable; do not estimate benchmark tokens

serving.device_requirement: one NVIDIA A100 80GB with at least 70 GiB free before startup
serving.gpu_selection: explicit CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES; never terminate unrelated jobs
serving.installation: reuse verified A100 environment; package version is an observed development build, not a promised PyPI wheel
serving.launch_environment: prepend serving interpreter bin directory to PATH so ninja is available for FlashInfer JIT

encoder.cache: keyed by encoder revision + exact text

datasets.name: HotpotQA
datasets.corpus: dataset-provided distractor context at pinned revision
datasets.retriever: ordered supplied records; no external corpus

datasets.name: GAIA
datasets.attachments: require all task attachments with content hashes
datasets.web_protocol: capture immutable per-task web/tool evidence snapshot before controlled replay
datasets.missing_assets: block task and mark cohort incomplete; never silently filter tasks

partition.sample_selection: hash-sort task IDs within benchmark/category strata; freeze manifest before any model call
partition.family_definition: provided family_id preferred; otherwise normalized question template replacing numeric literals; fallback does not prove semantic/entity disjointness
partition.leakage_prevention: union task families, duplicate normalized prompts and supplied entity/template leakage_keys before assigning group-disjoint partitions
partition.group_assignment: seeded deterministic group ordering with 60/20/20 group allocation; never split one family to hit a task count
partition.actual_counts: written to immutable sample_manifest; fail a protocol if required cohort cannot be formed
partition.target_library: frozen; no retrieval-statistic, distillation, verification or merge updates from target tasks
partition.protocol_interpretation: source/validation/target are internal disjoint folds of the specified labeled benchmark pool, not the original provider train/dev/test split

evaluation.failures: retain in denominator; quality=0 for model/contract failures; infra failures block publication
evaluation.bootstrap_unit: task family, keeping methods and seeds paired

construction_diagnostic.counting: 1200 base workflows; intervention runs recorded separately

execution_diagnostic.counting: 1000 fixed workflows; replay executions are not new generated workflows

construction_main.availability: must report actually implemented methods; full 7-method table blocked while A2Flow is unreleased

construction.compatibility: no conflicts_with, no shared exclusive_group; all structured preconditions must hold; model may remove/reorder but cannot bypass checks
construction.tie_breaking: descending total score then ascending policy ID
construction.aggregate_cost: weighted mean of per-pair relative reductions; graph cost = nodes + edges

distillation.eligibility: valid, zero contract violations, quality >= paired base, weighted cost reduction >= 0.05, source Pareto frontier
distillation.reference: same-task/seed no-policy planner under complete runtime

planner.policy_removal: drop all after bounded conditioned repairs; one bounded base-planner attempt

statistics.utility_update: mean(clip(weighted_paired_cost_reduction,0,1)) over all unique paired held-out observations
statistics.confidence_update: Wilson lower bound for quality-and-cost-success proportion
statistics.success_rule: valid and delta_quality >= -quality_tolerance and weighted_cost_reduction >= minimum_cost_reduction

library.eviction: lowest confidence, then utility, then oldest update round, then policy ID
library.negative_evidence: persist every rejected paired outcome; excluded from default target retrieval
library.versioning: stable policy ID; increment on merge; preserve original operation/precondition; union evidence IDs; preserve parent links
library.merge: keep verified rule semantics; union positive/negative evidence; recompute utility/confidence from deduplicated pairs
library.expert_snapshot: exact initial hand-written templates; not labeled empirically verified

method_definitions.sequential: one semantically ready call at a time; complete barriers
method_definitions.independent_only: in-house topological-level barriers; independent calls in same level run concurrently; NOT the external LLMCompiler implementation
method_definitions.complete_dependency: in-house event-driven complete-result barriers with effects/resources; NOT the external LLMOrch implementation
method_definitions.percentage_threshold: early only when required values exist and materialized top-level schema-field fraction >= threshold; exact stability intentionally omitted; effects/resources retained
method_definitions.guarded: all exact fields stable, monotone producer, cancellable early-safe consumer, effect/resource guards

execution.percentage_denominator: number of declared top-level output properties; numerator counts present properties
execution.queue_policy: FIFO by first-ready timestamp; tie by topological order
execution.fairness: finite DAG + FIFO fit scan; no unbounded dynamic spawning
execution.failure_recovery: fail call, cancel/invalidate all dependent descendants including completed speculative results; return failed task; do not reissue externally visible effects

effects.ordering: explicit effect-dependency edges; completion barrier unless partial-safe declared
effects.compensation: disabled in reference profile; compensable calls retain completion barriers

stream.format: NDJSON immutable named fields; Partial/Complete/Failure events
stream.sequence: consecutive integers per call; starts at 0
stream.duplicates: identical event ID and payload ignored by materializer; mismatching duplicate is contract failure
stream.out_of_order: reject; transport adapter must order before materialization
stream.llm_stability: emit one complete JSON string field at newline; reject overwrite; raw token prefixes are never stable values
stream.dynamic_per_item: reference profile uses bounded declared item instances from task schema; dynamic graph mutation disabled
stream.input_versions: one attempt per logical call; failed producer invalidates all consumed versions; retry disabled

replay.coverage: 100% of workflow model/tool calls in execution comparison; planner excluded from fixed-graph timing
replay.key: sha256(canonical JSON {workflow_id,call_id,arguments}); sorted keys; UTF-8; finite JSON only
replay.miss: fail; never nearest-match or live fallback
replay.method_order: seeded permutation for each workflow and repetition
replay.cache_state: bundle preloaded before timing; HTTP/model caches excluded from replay
replay.network_state: recorded call delays replayed; no network calls during timed execution

shared.target_ground_truth: never available to planner/search; scoring only
shared.budget_accounting: include search separately and amortized over target tasks; no hidden free optimization

a2flow.hyperparameter_provenance: proposed matched-budget reference preset; not recovered A2Flow author settings

expert_policies.selection: deterministic applicability + compatibility, at most k

static_library.snapshot_hash: generated and frozen before target evaluation

llmorch.implementation: not located in author-linked source during this session

baselines.reporting: Do not label in-house scheduling controls as external baseline reproductions; unavailable methods remain explicitly absent.

without_policy_selection.selection: top-k applicable candidates; compiler/planner safety checks retained

without_heldout_verification.admission: static contract check only; source-only experimental library; never overwrite verified library

without_effect_guard.allowed_data: pure recorded calls only; never live effects

without_resource_guard.allowed_data: offline replay only; never live overload

metrics.quality_units: fraction [0,1] internally; multiply deltas by 100 for percentage points
metrics.token_reporting: per-task construction+execution and separately total offline evolution; amortized total includes evolution/target_task_count
metrics.topology_instability: mean normalized labeled graph edit distance over same-task distinct generation seeds; report bounded-search timeouts separately
metrics.e2e_start: task submission to fixed-graph runtime; construction time logged separately
metrics.ttfo: first externally visible declared sink output; never first internal tool event

contract_safety.denominator: unique logical calls launched before at least one producer completes
contract_safety.counting: one primary category per violating early logical call; priority is a reference choice because paper does not specify ties
contract_safety.aggregate: sum of four disjoint counts / early logical calls
contract_safety.incomplete_audit: serialize rates as null; retain known counts and unassessed count
contract_safety.pooling: sum counts and denominators over identical cohorts; do not average percentages
contract_safety.paper_number_policy: never seed 0.0 or 0.63 into computed results; original logs are required to resolve paper inconsistency

metrics.legacy_violation_incidence: all detected incidents / all dispatches; separate diagnostic, not Eq.38
metrics.unsafe_dispatch: number of dispatched calls violating exact data readiness or mandatory effect ordering / all dispatched calls
metrics.early_unsafe_rate: unsafe early calls / all early-dispatched calls, separate metric
metrics.cross_benchmark_aggregation: macro-average benchmark scores; never pool different native quality metrics without labeling

tools.gaia_capability_gate: block tasks requiring unavailable attachment/browser/audio/image tools; do not call subset accuracy full GAIA accuracy
tools.external_api_policy: record endpoint/version/time and snapshot actual observations; credentials never go into manifest
tools.network: loopback model service; external downloads only during dataset preparation

artifacts.redaction: no secrets, hostnames, user home paths or private endpoint credentials in public manifests
artifacts.missing_artifact: mark run incomplete; no invented results

provenance.reference_defaults: All other numerical settings and allocations are explicit implementation choices, not original paper hyperparameters.

ambiguity_resolutions.effect_safety: hard constraint, never traded for speed
